headline_findings: Off-the-shelf screenless Shenzhen health bands (HRV/SpO2/sleep claims, single-channel PPG, no gyro, closed firmware, white-label app) list on Alibaba at roughly $8.80-$12.55/unit with MOQs as low as 1-100 pieces; the Da Fit/MoYoung class of RTL8762 watches retails at ~$7 on Amazon [secondary: Alibaba screenless-band buying page; jphein/moyoung-watch README].

The cheap tier is cheap because of the silicon and the business model: Vcare/VC30F-class single-channel PPG or single-LED PixArt PAH8011 (~$2) instead of multichannel Goodix GH3026 (~$3 single-qty) or Maxim MAX86171-class AFEs (~$6), no gyroscope, Realtek/Jieli SoCs whose OTA path is a closed signed channel, and a vendor app (Da Fit, ZmooFit, 'G band', QRing) that owns the data pipeline [secondary: PulseLoop faceless-band survey; threkir BOM notes; jphein/moyoung-watch].

Custom-firmware paths that do exist in Shenzhen: J-Style/Jointcorp (Youhong) ECG bands with full iOS/Android SDK+API at MOQ 1,000; iSmarch screenless bands with GH3026-class multichannel PPG + ECG + EDA and protocol/SDK docs at MOQ 2,000-3,000 (EXW quote); Staranb GH3228T ECG band with SDK at 1-piece samples (~$15-25 est.); Starmax GTX2-class watches on Actions ATS3085 running Zephyr where custom firmware is reachable [secondary: PulseLoop survey; jphein docs].

Alibaba's own 2026 buying guides put full-custom OEM NRE at $150k-$400k plus $50k-$120k certification and $30k+ tooling, ODM MOQ at 2,000-3,000 and OEM MOQ at 5,000, and quote a mid-tier ODM smartwatch at $34/unit at 2,000 units vs $29/unit OEM plus ~$210k one-time; firmware SOURCE access is reported to require MOQs up to 50,000 [secondary: Alibaba OEM-vs-ODM wearable guides].

The direct Whoop clone benchmark is Amazfit Helio Strap: $99 one-time, BioTracker 6.0 PPG (5 photodiodes, 2 LEDs), accelerometer + gyroscope + temperature, BT 5.2, auto-recognition of 25 strength movements with sets/reps/rest; Zepp Health (ex-Huami, the Mi Band ODM) reports ~38-39% gross margin and hit adjusted operating breakeven in Q3 2025; a Helio Strap Pro shipped June 2026 [secondary: AndroidGuys review; Zepp stock-pitch note; CNET].

Whoop's own hardware, per TechInsights/the5krunner teardown citations, is Maxim MAX86171 AFE + MAX32652 secure MCU + MAX6631 with 5 LEDs (3 green, 1 red, 1 IR) and 4 photodiodes, 52 Hz IMU; the band streams raw 24-bit PPG unencrypted to the phone app and computes SpO2/skin-temp in the cloud; CBP ruling N339661 is titled 'The tariff classification of Whoop Bands from China' [verified title: CBP CROSS; secondary: openwhoop / johnmiddleton12 RE notes].

US landed-cost stack as of Sept 2026 (estimate built from secondary sources): MFN 0% for both 8517.62.00 and 9031.80.80; China Section 301 List 4A 7.5% for 8517.62.0090/9031.80.80-class goods; the July 24, 2026 forced-labor Section 301 action adds 12.5% for China vs 10% for India (India has committed to a forced-labor import ban); the Section 122 10% global surcharge expired July 24, 2026; IEEPA tariffs were struck down Feb 20, 2026; de minimis ended for all countries Aug 29, 2025 (EO 14324) [verified: EO text; secondary: USTR fact sheet via news digests, HTS tables].

Peer-reviewed accuracy gap is real but narrower than marketing implies: WHOOP 4.0 nocturnal rMSSD CCC 0.94 and Oura Gen 4 CCC 0.99 vs ECG (Dial 2025); WHOOP 3.0 rMSSD ICC 0.99 vs Apple Watch S6 0.67, Oura Gen 2 0.63, Garmin FR245 0.24 (Miller 2022); Whoop lnRMSSD bias 1.66% +/- 1.80%, LOA +/-5.93% (Bellenger 2021); no peer-reviewed validation of any Vcare/PAH8011-class white-label band was found [secondary: PMIDs 40834291, 36016077, 34065516 as cited in community research notes].

Goodix's PPG algorithm stack (HR/HRV/SpO2) ships as a binary library under a Goodix licence with a 'democode' driver; even Core Devices' open PebbleOS uses the GH3x2x driver with the vendor blob, so 'raw PPG + own algorithms' means either licensing Goodix/Maxim algorithms or writing your own DSP [secondary: coredevices/PebbleOS source; evenRealities-openCFW attribution docs].

Ultrahuman's own path was Bengaluru (first UltraFactory, India) then Plano, Texas (SVtronics partnership, operational Nov 2024, scaling to >500k rings/yr) - not Indore as the brief assumed; Oura's manufacturing site was not found in this session's sources (a 2019-era blog says 'made in Finland', unverified) [secondary: Ultrahuman press releases; Manufacturing.net].

Shenzhen cost floor for the physical build is low: JLCPCB economic SMT is $0.0016-$0.0017 per solder joint + $8 setup + $1.50 stencil + $3 per extended part type (2026), a 4-layer bare board is ~$70.6/m2 at JLCPCB rates, rigid-flex is roughly 6x rigid, 150-250 mAh thin LiPo cells are ~$2-8 at low MOQ (Grepow/Benzo custom cells quote-only) [secondary: JLCPCB price notes reproduced in engineering repos].

Method caveat: this lens completed only 10 live web searches before the session-wide WebSearch budget was exhausted and WebFetch/curl were egress-blocked; the remaining evidence was pulled from GitHub-indexed reproductions of primary text (EO 14324, HTSUS note 20(a), whoop.com captures) and dated engineering/news-digest repos, and is tagged accordingly.

detailed_notes:
# China (Shenzhen) manufacturing lens - screenless strength/health band

## 0. Method and evidence quality

This lens ran 10 live WebSearch queries before the session-wide search budget (200/200) was exhausted; WebFetch and curl were egress-blocked for every primary domain tried (rulings.cbp.gov, jlcpcb.com). The rest of the evidence came from the GitHub API: reproductions of primary text (Executive Order 14324, HTSUS chapter 99 note 20(a), verbatim whoop.com captures dated 2026-06-24), dated news-digest corpora that cite USTR/Federal Register/Flexport (Supwils/swil-news, ora-commons/msi-corpus), and engineering repos that reverse-engineer the exact devices in question (jphein/moyoung-watch, kevdagoat/zepp-os-esphome, hunterchen7/openwhoop, foureight84/PulseLoopAndroid, coredevices/PebbleOS). Confidence tags: 'verified' only where official text was seen; 'secondary' for trade press, analyst notes and community engineering documents; 'estimate' for anything computed here. Where a number could not be found it is marked 'not found'.

## 1. White-label pricing (Alibaba/1688 tier)

- Alibaba's screenless-band buying page quotes Shenzhen OEM bands with 'HRV, SpO2, sleep' at $8.80-$12.55/unit; the showroom lists bands from $11.5; MOQs 1-100 pcs; 90+ suppliers, Guangdong-centric; Shenzhen Yawell (ISO/BSCI) is the named example. 1688 (domestic) pricing could not be searched.
- Reverse-engineering evidence explains the price: the Da Fit / MoYoung-v2 family are '~$7 RTL8762-class rectangles' (Amazon retail) - Realtek BLE SoC, stock firmware, OTA over Realtek's closed signed path; only watch faces are user-modifiable. ZmooFit (P5S) is the same RTL8762 class. Cheapest bands use Vcare VC30F/VC31B single-channel PPG with 'algorithmic' HRV; PixArt PAH8011 (~$2, single LED) is the cheapest viable optical HR part and is measurably worse in low perfusion.
- Smart rings: Colmi/Yawell R02-R12 retail $15-25 and, unusually, allow custom firmware (OTA/SWD/SDK); 56ff/Jring rings $7-12 with open-source firmware. Rogbid Loop/Loop Air (Goodix GH3228 PPG+ECG; JL7073A8 + GPS variant) retail $60-70 with no public OEM/SDK program.
- Why cheap, in one line: single-channel PPG, no gyroscope, sub-$1 SoC, no raw data access, closed firmware, and a shared white-label app (Da Fit, QRing/Oudmon 'Jxr35' protocol, 'G band', FitCloudPro/H Band) that the ODM controls. None of these ODMs is FDA-cleared (openFDA 510(k): no J-Style/Youhong/Yawell entries).

## 2. ODM/JDM houses with custom firmware or SDK access

- J-Style / Jointcorp (Shenzhen Youhong): JCVital V8 / J1790 ECG bands on Goodix GH322x, ISO 13485, CE/FCC, MOQ 1,000, full iOS/Android SDK + API (best documented in the survey), price quote-only.
- iSmarch (Shenzhen): screenless/hybrid variants with GH3026-class multichannel 500 Hz PPG + ECG + EDA + accel, MOQ 2,000-3,000, EXW quote, supplies hardware + protocol/SDK docs so the buyer builds the app - closest match to FitForge's need for raw-ish data.
- Shenzhen Staranb: GH3228T ECG band, 1-piece samples, ~$15-25 est., SDK + API advertised.
- Goodway Technologies E900 (= Valdus Vitro / 'G band'): Jieli JL7013A + GH3228T + PD2325 photodiode + DA267 accel; MOQ/price undisclosed; SDK not advertised.
- Starmax (istarmax.com): GTX2 watch on Actions ATS3085 running Zephyr - custom firmware is reachable, unlike RTL8762 devices.
- Zepp Health (ex-Huami, Amazfit; HQ moved to the Netherlands in May 2025): the large accessible ODM - built the Xiaomi Mi Band line and Timex-branded watches; MOQs 'in the thousands' with upfront NRE; a skinned Zepp OS is the easy deal, deep firmware access is the hard ask. Gross margin ~38-39%, adjusted operating breakeven Q3 2025, revenue +78.5% YoY, TTM revenue ~$233M, market cap ~$264-269M (stock-pitch note; verify in 20-F/6-K).
- Goertek and Luxshare are tier-1 EMS (AirPods; Apple Watch assembly is primarily Compal/Luxshare; Goertek is Meta's AR/VR ODM) - not realistic for 5k-25k unit programs (estimate). Desay, Do Intelligent, iWOWN, Kospet, Moko, Wisesmart: no usable data surfaced this session.
- Alibaba's 2026 guides (marketing, but consistent with the above): OEM NRE $150k-$400k, certification $50k-$120k, tooling $30k+; ODM MOQ 2,000-3,000, OEM MOQ 5,000, SDK customization from MOQ 500; firmware source access reported at MOQs up to 50,000; mid-tier ODM GPS smartwatch $34/unit at 2,000 vs OEM $29/unit + $210k one-time. Shenzhen houses now bundle PCB layout, sensor calibration, FCC/CE/RED and packaging. OTA capability is table stakes.
- Jieli publishes its BLE SDKs on GitHub (fw-AW31N_BLE_SDK, fw-AC63_BT_SDK, bootloader, OTA libraries) - the one Shenzhen SoC vendor with a genuinely open firmware path; Telink's TLSR825x SDK is public too. Nordic remains the default for Western-designed straps (XBAND/Codex = GH3026 + nRF52840, ~$279 retail).

## 3. Component cost reality (Shenzhen)

- PPG AFE: Goodix GH3026 ~$3 single-qty (10k+ typically 40-60% of that), $3-8 RFQ/NDA per a 2026-08 note; GH3011 is the 3-LED-driver single-PD part; GH3220/GH3228/GH3228T add single-lead ECG at 500 Hz; PAH8011 ~$2; Maxim MAX86177 ~$6 (MAX86178 ~$8, adds ECG+BioZ); TI AFE49I30 $5-12; ams AS7058 $5-15. Goodix documentation is China-first and the HR/HRV/SpO2 algorithms are a licensed binary blob shipped with a 'democode' driver (even Core Devices' PebbleOS carries it under the Goodix 5-clause licence). Xiaomi Mi Band 8 = GH3026 + Bosch BHI260AP + Ambiq Apollo3 Blue.
- IMU: Bosch BMI270 ~$2-4, TDK ICM-42688-P ~$3-5, BHI260AP ~$5-8 (community estimates). QST QMI8658 price not found; it is the default IMU on Waveshare/ESP32 boards, implying the cheapest volume option. Cheap bands use DA267 (MiraMEMS) or similar 3-axis parts and skip the gyro entirely.
- BLE SoC: nRF52832 pre-certified module $2-3 at 1k (bare die cheaper); nRF54LS05 entry parts (production Q3 2026) target nRF52832-level BOM. Telink TLSR8253, Realtek RTL8762, Bluetrum, Jieli: unit prices not found; a $7 retail watch implies sub-$1 SoCs (inference).
- Battery: 150 mAh 601520-class LiPo ~$2-4 small-qty, ultra-thin 110-250 mAh ~$3-8 at MOQ, curved/custom cells (Grepow, Benzo) quote-only; EVE pricing not found.
- PCB/SMT: JLCPCB 4-layer laminate ~$70.6/m2 (a 3 cm2 band board is cents of material); rigid-flex ~6x rigid; economic SMT $0.0016-0.0017 per joint + $8 setup + $1.50 stencil + $3 per extended part type (2026), lower at 50k+ joints. Placement cost for a ~150-200 joint band is ~$0.25-0.35 (estimate).

## 4. Landed cost to the US (Sept 2026)

- Classification: modern connected trackers go to 8517.62 (General: Free) per WCO 2018-19 guidance; CBP has also used 9031.80 (Free) where essential character is physiological measurement (Fitbit Tracker from Singapore -> 9031.80.8085 in NY N068636; HQ H279898 covers later Fitbits; NY N291933 covers trackers from China; N339661 covers Whoop bands from China - text not retrievable). Get a binding ruling.
- Section 301: List 4A 7.5% applies to 8517.62.0090-class and 9031.80.80 goods (secondary table); note 20(a) carved 8517.62.0090 out of List 1. Lists 1-3 are 25%. Section 301 survived the Supreme Court's Feb 20, 2026 IEEPA decision.
- 2026 sequence: IEEPA reciprocal/fentanyl tariffs void (refunds via CAPE); Section 122 10% global surcharge Feb 24 - Jul 24, 2026; from Jul 24, 2026 USTR forced-labor Section 301 duties on ~60 economies: 12.5% China, 10% India (India moved to the committed-to-ban group in the final action), with exemptions for Section 232 goods, USMCA goods, some raw materials; Taiwan's annex exempts 8517.62 - unknown for China/India. China's MOFCOM cited a US pledge that substitute tariffs on Chinese goods would not exceed 20%. US-China reciprocal-tariff suspension runs to about Nov 10, 2026; a US-India interim deal was 'very close' in late June 2026 but no conclusion was found.
- De minimis: EO 14324 (signed Jul 30, 2025) suspended duty-free de minimis for all countries from Aug 29, 2025 (China/HK from May 2, 2025). Direct-ship-from-factory to US consumers is fully dutiable for both origins.
- Estimated duty stacks: China-origin band ~20% (7.5 + 12.5) of customs value, possibly 7.5% if 8517.62 is exempt in China's annex; India-origin ~10%, possibly 0% if exempt or under a deal. Add MPF/HMF and ocean/air freight for both.

## 5. IP, quality and the path others took

- Firmware black boxes: Da Fit/MoYoung OTA is closed and signed; Helio Strap uses Zepp OS ECDH-authenticated BLE (Gadgetbridge-derived) and the official data path is Zepp's cloud API, though a legacy Huami fetch path still yields per-minute data; Whoop streams raw 24-bit PPG and 6-axis IMU unencrypted to its app and computes SpO2/skin-temp in the cloud (SpO2 only during sleep, ~30 s every ~20 min). Lesson: in every tier the vendor, not the user, owns raw data unless you own the firmware.
- Accuracy: Dial 2025 - WHOOP 4.0 nocturnal rMSSD CCC 0.94, Oura Gen 4 0.99, Gen 3 0.97, Garmin 0.87, Polar 0.82; Miller 2022 - WHOOP 3.0 ICC 0.99 vs Apple Watch S6 0.67, Oura Gen 2 0.63, Garmin FR245 0.24 (WHOOP-supported study); Bellenger 2021 - lnRMSSD bias 1.66% +/- 1.80%, LOA +/-5.93% (independent). No validation of any Vcare/PAH8011-class band exists in the sources; PPG gives PRV not HRV and degrades with motion and in clinical populations. WHOOP Strain has no independent validation (Bellenger 2022). Algorithms change with firmware, which is a longitudinal-consistency problem FitForge can avoid by owning the pipeline.
- Clones: the ODM ecosystem is built on shared reference designs; expect your enclosure and feature set to be resold. Protect the app/algorithm layer, not the band.
- Paths taken: Whoop - China-made (CBP ruling), Maxim silicon, cloud DSP, $199-359/yr membership bundling the device; Amazfit Helio Strap - Zepp's own factories/ODM stack, $99, BioTracker 6.0 (5 PD/2 LED), gyro, 25-movement strength auto-detection; Ultrahuman - Bengaluru first, then Plano, Texas with SVtronics (Nov 2024, >500k/yr) explicitly to serve US demand tariff-free; Oura - manufacturing site not verified here; XBAND/Codex - GH3026 + nRF52840 strap at $279 with no OEM program.

## 6. Like-for-like unit-cost table (all 'estimate'; ex-works, USD/unit)

| Option | Spec | 5k | 25k | 100k | NRE |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| China ODM white-label | single-channel PPG, 3-axis accel, RTL8762/Jieli, stock firmware, Da Fit-class app, no raw data | 9-13 | 8-11 | 7-9 | ~$1-3k logo/packaging |
| China custom JDM | GH3026-class multichannel PPG, 6-axis IMU (gyro), Nordic/Realtek BLE, custom firmware + raw BLE stream, FCC/CE | 18-28 | 14-22 | 11-17 | $30-150k (platform customization) to $150-400k + certs $50-120k + tooling $30k+ (ground-up) |
| India EMS, own design | same JDM spec, imported actives | 22-35 | 17-26 | 13-20 | similar design NRE; see india lens |

Landed-to-US at 25k (estimate): China JDM ~$18 x 1.20 duty = ~$21.6; India ~$21 x 1.10 = ~$23.1 - near parity after duties, with India ahead if 8517.62 is exempted or a US-India deal lands, and China ahead on speed, component proximity and ODM depth. Reasoning inputs: BOM lines in section 3, Alibaba $34/$29 anchors, Helio Strap $99 retail at ~38% gross margin (implies fully loaded COGS well under $60), and the tariff stack in section 4.

## 7. Implications for FitForge

- The screenless white-label tier cannot deliver strength-set detection (no gyro, no raw IMU) or trustworthy HRV; it is only a price floor (~$8-12).
- The viable China route is a JDM with iSmarch/J-Style-class houses or a Zepp-tier ODM, insisting on raw PPG/IMU over BLE and OTA keys you hold; budget for a Goodix or Maxim algorithm licence or your own DSP.
- Whoop-class sensing (multi-PD, red+IR, 26-52 Hz) is achievable with GH3026/MAX8617x + a 6-axis IMU at a BOM in the low teens at 25k, which is consistent with a $99-149 no-subscription retail price.

India-side inputs the table depends on: EMS conversion cost per unit at 5k/25k/100k, BCD on imported PPG/IMU/SoC/cells under the wearables PLI/duty-concession lists (covered by the india-manufacturing lens).
